lines.text: The LORD led them forty years in the wilderness to humble and test them, and fed them manna.
Their clothing did not wear out, and the LORD disciplines them as a man disciplines his son.
The good land has wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, plus olive oil and milk.
In wealth, their hearts will become proud and they will forget the LORD who freed them from Egypt.
The LORD brought them water from the Nile River, and fed them manna to humble and test them.
